notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Program.UnitFrames.cs draws the player and target frames on the real mirrored UI-TargetingFrame art with correct recessed layering: portrait (live-baked or fallback), health/power bars with power-type colors, faction-tinted target name background, name + level text with difficulty color, high-level skull, DEAD text, combat flash, and the target's buff/debuff rows with dispel-tinted UI-Debuff-Overlays borders and stack counts (DrawTargetAuras). The file itself enumerates its absent elements for parity capture.
